name: Druidic Prowess
description: Each Druidic Prowess grants 10% increased Skill Speed and causes Hits with Spell Damage to grant 3 Rage. Maximum 3 Druidic Prowess.
keywordDefinition: Druidic Prowess is a stacking Buff which grants 10% increased Skill Speed and causes Hits with Spell Damage to grant 3 Rage per stack for 10 seconds. Each stack has an independent duration. Maximum 3 stacks.
